summary: Public Policy Holding Company (PPHC) filed an 8-K reporting completion of its acquisition of Tancredi Intelligent Communication Ltd. The press release lacks exact price, premium, or share terms but notes the deal is earnings-accretive, adding 22 staff and $4.3M net revenues (2025). Tancredi operates under PPHC's TrailRunner International. PPHC's board recommended the deal. No regulatory clock or break fee mentioned. Watch for post-close integration details to assess accretion timing.
